## Implementation status (post-implementation re-review)
This slice is IMPLEMENTED and committed (Gerrit 1889, stacked on the C3 chain) in the worktree this plan is re-reviewed against. The 26 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows below were recorded by slice C1 for the cli/commands subsystem and are REMOVED by this slice's commit, so a re-review reading the current `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` correctly sees ZERO rows for these paths and the ownership gate passing. That drained state is the INTENDED END STATE; the enumeration below is the C1 worklist this slice discharges. No further code change is proposed beyond what is committed.

## Context
Slice C1 (29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 26 below-seam ambient config/credential reads in the cli/commands subsystem (`_cli`, `_commands`) as `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows. RP-04 is not done while these sit below the seams enforced by `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab. Each row is still flagged when drained (owner=composition in a non-root file); none already owned.

The 26 reads: 14 `load_config` + 12 others — `REBAR_ROOT` in `_cli/_init.py` & `_commands/init.py`; `_jira_onboard.py::{JIRA_PROJECT,JIRA_URL,JIRA_USER,os.environ.get}`; `_llm_eval_commands.py::OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `bridge_repair.py::USER`; `tracker_maintenance.py::USER`; `compact_txn.py::REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER`; `composer.py::REBAR_DETECTED_BY`; `session_id.py::os.environ.get`. Affected SOURCE files: the 22 read-sites plus `config.py`, `_config_sources.py` (owned resolvers), `config_ownership_exceptions.py` (remove rows).

## Outcome
Each read gets one treatment and its row is removed. `check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths, no path-glob exception. Behavioral suites stay green; operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except recorded deltas.

## Decision rule
- **(a) CUT-TO-SEAM (24 of 26).** A composed-config read is routed through an OWNED `config.py`/`_config_sources.py` resolver instead of an ambient `load_config`/`os.environ` below the seam. The CLI entrypoint composes once and threads the typed value into the below-seam helper (signature changes to RECEIVE it, or the helper reads the owned resolver internally). Timing preserved: a LIVE-per-operation read is cut to a resolver that ALSO reads env live per call. None of these 24 is live-per-operation (CLI resolves each once at entry), per the compose-once proof.
- **(b) OWNED-IN-PLACE via `# read-via:` marker (capped at 2 reads = 2 marked lines).** A read that is NOT composed config (test-only or harness/protocol env-injection) keeps a `# read-via:` marker naming the category. No other listed read may be marked.

### Owned-in-place allowlist (2 marked lines — the cap)
1. `compact_txn.py` L186 `REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER` — test-only failpoint, inert in production. 1 line.
2. `session_id.py` L57 dynamic `os.environ.get(var)` — harness/protocol env-injection of session identity (`REBAR_SESSION_ID`/`AI_AGENT`/`CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID`), read live by `resolve_session_id()`. Shim↔rebar protocol contract, not a config knob. 1 line.

## Cut targets (reuse OWNED resolvers)
- **14 `load_config`** (`_cli/_audit_commands.py`, `_cli/_jira_onboard.py`, `_commands/{_seam,claim,close_autoresume,compact,compact_trigger,gates,metrics,remote_cert,scratch,verify_authorship,verify_commit,verify_opcert}.py`): CLI composes once at entry and threads the typed `Config`/field into the helper; below-seam `load_config` removed.
- **2 `REBAR_ROOT`** (`_cli/_init.py`, `_commands/init.py`): duplicate root-discovery that stops at git-toplevel (no cwd fallback) to detect not-found. CUT to a NEW owned `_config_sources.repo_root_or_none(explicit)` (`explicit > REBAR_ROOT > git-toplevel`; None when unresolved), threaded so `_init` maps None→exit 1 and `init` returns None.
- **5 jira reads** (`_jira_onboard.py` JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT overlay + `_TOKEN_ENV` detection + presence-gate + `load_config`): CUT to an OWNED jira-detection resolver (file+env, fail-soft ConfigError→env-only, token at credential boundary) returning url/user/project + a `token_present` flag; no env re-read survives or is marked.
- **`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`** (`_llm_eval_commands.py`) and **`REBAR_DETECTED_BY`** (`composer.py`): CLI-arg-with-env-default. CUT — the arg still wins; env is the composed default in an OWNED resolver.
- **2 `USER`** (`bridge_repair._actor`, `tracker_maintenance._actor`): OS-user audit fallback after git identity. CUT to a shared OWNED `resolve_os_actor(tracker)` that TAKES the dir and scopes the SAME `git -C <tracker> config user.email` lookup (git > `$USER` > "unknown") — preserves each caller's dir-scoped identity.

## Plan
1. Reuse/add the OWNED resolvers; cut the 24 composed-config reads through them (thread values into below-seam helpers).
2. Re-derive changed call sites (Serena `find_referencing_symbols` + a `grep` for the name as a string) and bring into scope, or keep the helper reading an OWNED resolver internally.
3. Mark the 2 owned-in-place reads; no other markers. Remove the 26 rows. Run `check_config_ownership.py` + suites; keep green.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
Held-out `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py` asserts: (i) `check_config_ownership.check(REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding for the 22 listed paths; (ii) `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` has zero entries for a listed file; (iii) `# read-via:` markers total exactly 2, confined to `compact_txn.py` (1) + `session_id.py` (1). Compose-once proof: a held-out fixture composes the entrypoint config, mutates each cut env var mid-operation, and asserts the threaded value is UNCHANGED (each cut read is entry-time). Affected suites updated where a signature changed: `tests/unit/{test_audit_*,test_claim_default_assignee,test_compact_*,test_remote_cert,test_verify_commit_ticket,test_verify_opcert*,test_jira_onboard,test_session_id,test_init_*}.py`, `tests/interfaces/{lifecycle,queries}`. Env-setting tests that only set the cut env vars at entry need no change.

## Compatibility / rollback
No stored format changes. Cut-to-seam is routing/threading; the 2 marked lines are inline annotations. Rollback = revert.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No ambient config/credential read below the seam in the 22 listed files: each is cut-to-seam (24) or one of the 2 owned-in-place reads with a `# read-via:` rationale; any live read cut to a live-per-call resolver.
- [x] The 26 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows removed; `check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception (proven by the held-out test incl. marker-total==2 / per-file-placement).
- [x] The Testing suites pass; operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except deltas recorded in a comment.
